card.name: Two-colourings without a monochromatic octahedron K2,2,2 (R(K2,2,2))

task.name: Two-colourings without a monochromatic octahedron K2,2,2 (R(K2,2,2))
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: colour 0 or 1 for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 31. Neither colour class may contain K2,2,2 as a (not necessarily induced) subgraph. Maximize n. A valid colouring of K_n certifies R(K2,2,2) > n. The record has 29 vertices; a 30-vertex colouring would prove R(K2,2,2) = 31.
